mapper.select: SELECT i.img_id AS imgId, i.original_name AS originalName, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.caption AS caption, i.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM image i JOIN image_block ib ON ib.img_block_id = i.img_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = ib.block_id JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.deleted_at DESC
